purpose: Validation-only screen of a single-Mamba-scan, lightweight multi-scale patch mixer retaining the AutoCon representation path.
research_question: Can the one-scan v13 temporal multi-scale residual improve on MambaTSv3 AutoCon and remain competitive with strong baselines across ETT, Weather, and high-dimensional traffic?
architecture: MambaTSv13 runs one shared Mamba-1 patch-state encoder, applies parallel depthwise kernel-3 and kernel-5 filters over observed patch states, and adds their equal-weight, zero-initialized ReZero residual to the shared state consumed by both the forecast and AutoCon representation heads.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics, predictions, or test checkpoints are generated. Passing requires a separately registered held-out release.
claim_boundary: This screen cannot establish universal forecasting, causal AutoCon attribution, or speed superiority. The independently measured same-shape v13 latency is retained as a constraint.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh1, Weather, and PEMS07 hashes and exact 54-job expansion
freeze v13 filters, ReZero initialization, AutoCon settings, and training budget
run all phases under the immutable launch sidecar
preserve source snapshot and output roots

selection_contract.freeze_rule: v13 filters, ReZero initialization, AutoCon lambda, and all optimizer settings are frozen before this matrix.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: External baselines receive no v13-specific flags or AutoCon objective.

phases.purpose: One-scan v13 AutoCon candidate on PEMS07 H12.

phases.purpose: Current one-scan v3 AutoCon reference under the same budget.

phases.purpose: Current one-scan v3 AutoCon reference on PEMS07 H12.

phases.name: strong_baselines_h96_h12_validation
phases.purpose: Strong same-source baselines without candidate-only flags.

phases.purpose: Strong same-source baselines on PEMS07 H12.

stopping_rules: Stop a coordinate if v13 is more than 2% worse than the strongest registered baseline.
Stop the architecture if v13 is more than 1% worse than v3 or has fewer than two of three paired seed wins on any dataset.
Do not release held-out test from a failed coordinate.
Do not claim speed superiority from this screen: same-shape resource measurements must show an explicit named-comparator win.
